visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Collapse the Special Cases
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The height function has separate branches for leaves, a missing left child, a missing right child and the two orderings. One base case and a max replace all of them. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Treating NULL as height 0 makes the leaf and one-child cases fall out automatically: a leaf is 1 + max(0, 0). Fewer special cases means fewer places to be wrong.
